text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after going out with
Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you out so late. I just
really wanted
to go to that motorcycle
shop.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The motorcycles there are so cool... And
they
each have their own unique appeal!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yep! It all depends on the make, the
color, and a
bunch of other stuff...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's like... Hmmm, I dunno how to
describe it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You look at 'em and you just think,
"Damn!" But
anyways, it's an awesome
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Augh! Why can't I communicate my idea
of cool
to you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll understand better if I try out
some of
the "cool" stuff myself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah! Pretty smart! Let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And if it gives me a clearer grasp on the
different
points of cool, I might even be
able to master
coolness!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right then. Let's start with something
easy...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How about a cool way to order at a
cafe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to drop by a cafe that Vodka
goes to
regularly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
By the way, tell me how you usually
order.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's good. Makes ya sound like a
regular!
choice_data_list: コーヒーをブラックで

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, lemme do the orderin'. Here
goes...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll have the usual!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk A
text_block_list.text: The... usual?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yep. The usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What comes out is a parfait with tons of
whipped
cream.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A-a-are you kidding?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You know there's no way somethin' this
childish is
my usual!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! I've never had a Strawberry
Fluffy
Mousse Parfait with Whipped
Cream before in my
life!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...W-wait a sec! I didn't say I wouldn't
eat it.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、注文し直そうか……

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a big fan of parfaits, but keepin'
quiet and
eating what you're given is
part of bein' cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Anyway, here goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it looks so good... Ah, scratch
that—I
didn't say anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon saying this, Vodka digs straight
into the
parfait.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is that cool? You're just orderin' a
regular coffee.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Interesting. So that's how adults show
their
coolness.
choice_data_list: ブラック、というところが大事なんだ
ブラック、というところが大事なんだよ
choice_data_list_en: The fact that it's black is what's important.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Let's order.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put the black coffee to my lips and let
the rich
scent fill my senses. It's
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa. Looks like you're enjoying it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, but I still can't say you're cool
yet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Oh, r-right!
choice_data_list: ウオッカは注文しないのか？
ウオッカ注文しないの？
choice_data_list_en: Aren't you going to order, Vodka?
Aren't you going to order, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A black coffee soon appears in front of
Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
N-no, nothing. The coffee looks so
good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka takes the cup in her hands, puts
on a
brave face, and gulps it down.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
U-urgh... That's...bitter... But the
bitterness... is so
good!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If ya put milk or sugar in it, it'd just
overpower
the coffee beans!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Coffee totally needs to be black!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pretend not to see the tears in Vodka's
eyes
after she finishes the cup.
